title: eng hiring & onboarding — team health + standup log (week of 2026-02-24)
content:
Objective: capture hiring / onboarding progress, interview debriefs, and team health signals from daily standups and onboarding syncs for platform-engineering. Mostly notes + action items; use for weekly sync and handoff to recruiting/people ops.

Summary (high level):
- Hiring: 3 active reqs (SRE IC3, Backend Eng IC4, Onboarding SWEs x2). Two candidates in final loop for Backend IC4. Recruiting ramping pipeline for SRE role; first onsite debrief scheduled 2026-03-02.
- Onboarding: 2 new hires started this week (Nora Kim — infra; Samir Gupta — platform tools). Both completed week-1 checklist except for environment access delays (see blockers). Buddy assignments set.
- Team health: bandwidth tight on release tasks; morale OK but signals of burnout on small subteam (release-engineering). Recommendation: defer non-blocking infra refactor to next sprint and prioritize async docs.

Daily standup highlights (2026-02-24 to 2026-03-02):
- 2026-02-24 (Mon):
  - Nora: completed laptop + VPN + repo access; still waiting for GCP project role (IAM) — blocked on security review (ticket CONFL-4248).
  - Samir: onboarding checklist 60% — needs access to test clusters; buddy assigned (Marcus).
  - Release team: smoke tests flaky after kernel update; investigating rollback plan.
  - Hiring: backend IC4 on-site scheduling for 2026-03-05; interview loop updated with system-design focus.

- 2026-02-25 (Tue):
  - Interview debrief: Candidate B for Backend IC4 (loop: Priya, Elliot, Marcus) — strengths: distributed systems knowledge, good KV/caching design; concerns: limited infra-as-code experience. Consensus: strong hire if match with onboarding plan that includes IaC pairing. Action: recruiting to extend offer (Priya). Linked notes: JIRA-ENG-872.
  - Onboarding sync: Nora to shadow infra-weekly rotation; scheduled pairing sessions.

- 2026-02-26 (Wed):
  - Standup: SRE pipeline automation ticket blocked by flaky test harness. Marcus to carve minimal repro and open followup.
  - Team health: small spike in incidents last two weeks — ask SRE to prepare postmortem template for recurring issues.

- 2026-02-27 (Thu):
  - Interview debrief: Candidate C (Backend IC4) — mixed feedback; strong coding, weaker design breadth. Decision: keep on bench; recommend loop for a senior systems engineer role instead. Action: Priya to give candidate feedback and loop to recruiting.
  - Onboarding: Samir still waiting for read-only access to prod-metrics; Escalation to infra-sre (Elliot) — created CONFL-4248.

- 2026-02-28 (Fri):
  - Weekly retro snippet: team feeling pressure from simultaneous release + onboarding. Proposal: dedicate half-day sprint for onboarding pairing and docs next week. Motion agreed by leads.
  - Hiring: SRE role candidate pipeline low (only 3 active). Recruiting is adding targeted outreach (Marcus).

- 2026-03-02 (Mon):
  - Final notes before weekly sync: Backend IC4 offer drafted pending compensation alignment. Nora completed environment access after IAM change (security sign-off on 2026-03-01).
  - Team health: one engineer flagged PTO burnout — manager to follow up.

Interview debriefs (short-form):
- Backend IC4 — Candidate B (strong hire): feedback consolidated, hiring manager approval pending. Strengths: system design, scale reasoning, GC/latency trade-offs. Weaknesses: Terraform experience moderate. Onboarding plan: 2-week IaC pairing + mentor. Next step: draft offer.
- Backend IC4 — Candidate C (no hire for this req): recommend alternate role exploration.
- SRE IC3 — onsite scheduled 2026-03-02 — team to prepare standard on-call + incident questions.

Onboarding sync (actions + checklist status):
- Nora Kim (Infra):
  - laptop: done
  - VPN/repo access: done
  - GCP IAM roles: completed 2026-03-01
  - 1:1s scheduled with Marcus and Elliot
  - Action items: pair on IaC module (Marcus) — scheduled 2026-03-04
- Samir Gupta (Platform Tools):
  - laptop: done
  - cluster creds: pending (escalated) — expected 2026-03-03
  - first task: small doc cleanup + test harness fix (owner: Samir)
  - Buddy: Marcus

Blockers and escalations:
- CONFL-4248: IAM access for new hires delayed due to security review queue. Status: escalated to security owner (Ava). ETA: 2026-03-01 (resolved).
- Flaky smoke tests after kernel bump — release-engineering to own rollback plan; need timeboxed mitigation.

Team health / signals:
- Positive: new hires onboarding smoothly once access resolved; cross-team pairing happening.
- Concern: release-engineering load (2 on-call overlaps + release cutoff). Recommend temporary shift in on-call coverage and postpone nonurgent infra refactor.
- Action: Priya to propose 1-week capacity buffer in next sprint planning; Marcus to update release schedule.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Recruiting: extend offer to Backend Candidate B (Priya) — due 2026-03-03.
- Marcus: schedule IaC pairing for Nora — due 2026-03-04.
- Elliot: follow up on test harness repro and open small-ticket to reduce flakiness — due 2026-03-05.
- Priya: propose capacity buffer to product/PMs and push noncritical refactor to next sprint — due 2026-03-06.
- Recruiting: increase targeted outreach for SRE IC3 role and share candidate list — due 2026-03-09.

Open questions / unresolved:
- Should we formalize a 2-week onboarding sprint for all new hires to reduce context-switch? (proposal for next leadership sync).
- Can release-engineering get temporary contractor support for the big release window? Need headcount approval.

Notes / references:
- Recruiting tracker: CONFL-4248 (pipeline + candidate notes)
- Interview rubric: https://confluence.redwood/guides/interview-rubric
- Related PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/456 (test harness patch)

Next sync: weekly hiring & onboarding review — 2026-03-09, 10:00 PT. Please update this doc with any post-offer or post-access changes before then.

Informal notes / snippets (raw, unpolished):
- "Samir is doing great — very proactive about test harness; once he has cluster creds he should be able to contribute to CI fixes ASAP."
- "Release team morale slightly frayed; small wins and shout-outs could help — consider one-page 'ship wins' email Friday."

Document history: created by Priya Patel on 2026-02-24; edits by Marcus Lee (2026-02-26), Elliot Johnson (2026-02-28), Ava Chen (2026-03-01).
